$comment: Scratch manifest for iterating on video-as-render-source content. Video files themselves are gitignored (see .gitignore) — only this manifest is tracked, so licensing/attribution and theme tags survive even as the actual clips get swapped out.

themes.grunge-abstract: Video feedback, kaleidoscope, ink/particle abstraction — pure texture, no representational content
themes.folk-horror: Masks, ritual costume, weird figures — Midlake/Shame-by-Brad/Wicker-Man vibe
themes.retro-psa-cold-war: 1950s-60s civil-defense and educational shorts, nuclear test/launch footage — Boards of Canada sample-source vibe
themes.urban-grunge: Cityscapes, traffic, transit, crowds, night neon
themes.people-scenery: Human figures in landscape, not urban
themes.urban-decay: Abandoned buildings, Chernobyl exclusion zone, decay, brutalist architecture — grungy and eerie
themes.vhs-glitch: VCR UI, CRT static, SMPTE bars, tape noise, double-exposure retro-TV art — analog/broadcast glitch texture
themes.carnival: Ferris wheels, carousels, fairground rides — nostalgic/uncanny fairground imagery
themes.vintage-8mm: Grainy Super-8/16mm-style home-movie footage — sprocket-hole framing, faded color or B/W, nostalgic/uncanny family-movie texture
